authorization: User approved launching the proposed follow-up. Run the first six singleton additions, interpret their results with hosted Codex, then register up to the six proposed follow-up masks. Do not reopen the completed original campaign or introduce other candidates.
fixed_policy: Use the original frozen v2 data, 84 initial observation months, 24 expanding score dates, signed LKJ eta2 rank2 GP, maxiter15, 256 scenarios and unchanged portfolio settings. Keep t_index. Optimize IC, Gaussian NLL and conventional Sharpe without a weighted score. Return and RMSE are diagnostic only; turnover excluded. No production change, new optimizer or formal new holdout.

batches.name: add_hy_level
batches.hypothesis: Isolate absolute credit state on the current lagged, annual-momentum-free lead; the existing highest-IC joint alternative also changes temporal inputs.

batches.name: add_hy_change
batches.hypothesis: Test whether the HY-change axis that helped U.S. equity density and Sharpe transfers to the current joint lead alongside normalized credit state.

batches.name: add_spy_proxy
batches.hypothesis: Test transfer of the market proxy that improved international-debt ranking and Sharpe in the final family context, without redefining its saved legacy formula.

batches.name: add_monthly_cpi
batches.hypothesis: Test monthly inflation information beyond annual CPI; international-debt family results suggest ranking/Sharpe gains with a possible NLL cost.

batches.name: add_schp_return
batches.hypothesis: Test whether the TIPS ETF return axis with strong U.S.-debt matched support transfers when added alone to the strong joint parent.

batches.name: add_nominal_yield
batches.hypothesis: Test nominal yield-level state beyond the retained term spread, using one Treasury-level name rather than adding identical duplicate columns.

batches.name: add_market_inflation_pair
batches.hypothesis: Compare the market/monthly-inflation pair with their singleton additions and unchanged parent to test conditional international-debt information and interaction effects.

batches.name: add_nominal_tips_pair
batches.hypothesis: Compare nominal yield and TIPS-return additions jointly with the singleton controls to test complementarity rather than assuming broad rate-block transfer.

batches.name: remove_intermediate_momentum
batches.hypothesis: Test whether six-month momentum still contributes alongside lag, skip momentum and trend in the final joint representation.

batches.name: annual_for_intermediate_momentum
batches.hypothesis: Compare annual momentum as a substitute for intermediate momentum, distinct from the already-tested unsuccessful simple annual-momentum addition.

batches.name: ma_for_trend
batches.hypothesis: Test whether the moving-average representation supported in U.S.-debt configurations is a better shared substitute for the current trend axis.

batches.name: remove_dollar_level
batches.hypothesis: Test dollar-level redundancy conditional on retained EM-FX return, oil, commodity ratio and the other shared predictors; do not infer universal irrelevance.
